legal_window: Every declared and independently valid transition in [anchor-3,anchor+3]; no cross-trajectory or synthetic padding.

natural.selection: Minimum natural-domain hash among all H4-legal anchors: uniform pseudorandom ranking over eligible anchors, independently by trajectory.
natural.missing: Keep a missing trajectory slot; do not replace.

extra.support_universe: H4-legal candidates for the letter after all natural selections are excluded.
extra.category_order: Compute support once before extras; ascending support then category_tie_order. Process all quota slots of a category consecutively; do not recompute rarity.
extra.candidate_order: Least total selected windows from that trajectory including natural, then extra-domain fixed hash, then trajectory_id,anchor. Recompute only trajectory load after every selection.
extra.deduplication: Every natural/extra (trajectory_id,anchor) is unique; all conditional labels retained even when they cross categories.
extra.missing: Preserve each unfilled requested slot and its reason; never substitute a different category or resample physical data.

truth_labels.basis: Anchor H1 truth only for extra category conditions; H4 endpoint/path labels independently retained.
truth_labels.boundary_moving: H1 moving and minimum actual wall gap over the anchor step's start/end states <=32worldpx, including all negative values.
truth_labels.likely_wall_blocked_proxy: Frozen native_rgb_motion_statistics.likely_wall_blocked_proxy; no wall force/contact measurement claim.
truth_labels.near_static_contact: Anchor H1 near_static and actual object-pusher contact.
truth_labels.near_static_no_contact: Anchor H1 near_static and no actual object-pusher contact.
truth_labels.intermediate: Anchor H1 neither moving nor near_static.

development.per_letter: One minimum development-natural hash from selected natural windows plus one minimum development-extra-moving hash from selected extra windows with H1 moving=true, regardless of allocated extra role.
development.missing: Report absent natural or extra-moving support; no fallback.

temporal_overlap_report: For same-trajectory selected pairs, count H4 state interval [a-3,a+4], H4 transition interval [a-3,a+3], future transition interval [a,a+3], and H1 state interval [a-3,a+1] overlaps independently.
prediction_status: Indices only. Zero model/optimizer/training-iterator calls; future inference deduplicates window_id and uses autoregressive predicted RGB feedback.
interpretation: Balanced-scene seen-letter development validation, not a natural real-world-frequency sample or an unbiased final test. Held-out DGKNQRWZ remain sealed.
